hero.title: Talk to the customer while you make it.
hero.description: Every bespoke order has its own chat, so questions about fit, fabric and finishing get answered in one place, on the order.

customer.title: One thread, on the order
customer.description: The customer chats from their order in the Qlozet shop. Their contact details stay private; the order's chat is how you reach each other.
points: Every message timed and kept with the order

opens.title: Opens when the work starts
opens.description: The chat opens once the order is in production and stays open while it's on the way, so conversations are about the piece you're making.
points: Open in production and in transit
The design and measurements are on the same order
Questions about measurements have their own tool too

alerts.title: Never miss a message
alerts.description: New messages show on the order's Message button and as a notification, for you and for the customer.
points: A burst of messages stays one notification
